requests.title: Ask the hospital about your record
requests.body: You can ask for your record to be erased, for a detail to be corrected, or for a nominee to be recorded. The request has no free text. The hospital's front desk takes it from there.
requests.kind: What do you want to ask?
requests.confirmBody: This sends a request to the hospital. A correction names the detail only, never the new value. Nothing is changed by sending it.
requests.already: This request was already on record.
requests.refused: This cannot be done for this account: it must be active and linked to a record at that hospital.
requests.invalid: That request was not accepted. Check your choices. Nothing was sent.

publicGrievance.title: Send a complaint without signing in
publicGrievance.body: This goes to the hospital without signing in. A person at the hospital reads it.
publicGrievance.confirmBody: This sends your message to the hospital. It is stored encrypted.
publicGrievance.noClinic: No hospital is set up to receive this right now. Nothing was sent.
publicGrievance.unavailable: This is not available right now. Nothing was sent.
publicGrievance.refused: This cannot be done right now. Nothing was sent.
